visual_job: Hook the viewer with a recognizable after-fight contradiction: the kitchen is normal, but her movements are not.
camera: Wide three-quarter kitchen view with warm off-white negative space, counter/sink visible, Aachu clearly alone.
action: Aachu scrubs one already-clean cup or counter spot too hard after the fight.
body_language: Shoulders tight, lips pressed, brow pinched but not raging; the emotion is in the over-focused chore.
micro_details: one spoon slightly out of place
swipe_reason: Why is she cleaning like that?

visual_job: Show her inner forgiveness rehearsal while her hand still betrays leftover irritation.
camera: Close/medium shot on her side profile and hand at the counter.
action: She pauses mid-cleaning with a thought bubble near her face.
body_language: Face softened by a notch; hand still gripping the cloth or cup too tightly.
micro_details: cup held a little too tightly
swipe_reason: Will she actually forgive him when he comes?

visual_job: Give visual proof that forgiveness has already started before she admits it.
camera: Medium close kitchen shot focused on the counter and her hands.
action: Without realizing it, she sets his cup/glass/chai space ready on the counter while still looking annoyed.
body_language: Eyes lowered, guarded face, but her hand places the cup carefully and almost gently.
swipe_reason: Her actions are saying something her face is not.

visual_job: Create the dramatic doorway turn: he arrives before her mouth has caught up to her hands.
camera: Deep doorway composition: Aachu foreground near the prepared cup, Zuv entering in the background.
action: The doorway catches Zuv entering; Aachu's hand freezes near the cup/glass she had just prepared.
body_language: Her hand stopped mid-air; his body half inside the doorway, normal and unaware of the incoming blast.
micro_details: prepared cup still visible on the counter
swipe_reason: The audience knows the cup is there before he does.

visual_job: Deliver the comic explosion: her mouth fails the forgiveness plan.
camera: Compact dramatic two-shot with Aachu foreground and Zuv frozen at the doorway.
action: Aachu turns fast with the kitchen cloth still in hand and shouts. Zuv freezes with keys or bag still in hand.
body_language: Aachu expressive and loud, not cruel. Zuv surprised, not saintly, not humiliated.
micro_details: tiny reaction ticks near his face
cloth held like an accidental prop
prepared cup partly visible but not yet foregrounded

visual_job: Land the silent payoff: he sees the prepared cup and understands she had already forgiven him through her hands.
camera: Aftermath freeze with the cup/glass in the foreground, Zuv noticing it, Aachu looking away.
action: Zuv's eyes drop to the cup already waiting for him. Aachu looks away, still holding the cloth, still annoyed but exposed.
body_language: He pauses in quiet understanding; she refuses eye contact because the cup has betrayed her softness.
micro_details: his expression softened but not smug
swipe_reason: The reveal reframes the whole carousel.
